PR #26550 merged at `9bf65989` (merged 2026-10-27T09:49Z). `9bf65989` is an ancestor of `origin/main`. On all 15 paths the PR touched, the merge tree matches the accepted head `7fb21ede` byte for byte.

The OAuth scope `metadata:write` is now in `MCP_OAUTH_SCOPES`, with consent copy for every scope in `MCP_OAUTH_SCOPE_CONSENT_COPY`. `handleHttpRequest(request, { authoring })` lists and serves a host's authoring tools only under a verified `metadata:write` grant. Every call gets a fresh, frozen door/actor/principal/environment context built from the host's inputs alone. The OSS runtime injects no authoring registry, so it serves no authoring tool on any path. That injection is cloud#3302's.

Carried on: #26587 (the Console consent page renders `metadata:write` raw, plus the `ai.json` "all three scopes" prose). The host notes for cloud#3302 are in the injection TSDoc. The card closed through `Fixes #26464`, and this seat removes `pm:dispatched`.
